assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production Unity mobile game UI navigation card sprite, square 1024x1024. Generate ONE complete framed WORLD MAP card. Image 1 is a reference for the map card subject and reserved live-label area, NOT an edit target and NEVER a screenshot to crop. Image 2 is the approved antique-gold and dark navy material/lighting style reference only; do not reproduce its logo or lettering. Front-facing square card with near-black navy opaque lacquer panel, a restrained narrow antique-gold rounded rectangular frame with modest carved corner filigree and tiny sapphire details. Complete frame fills the square with only 2 percent outer margin, all corners intact. Inner upper 72 percent holds an illustrated warm parchment map unfurled between curled wooden rods with a small sapphire-and-antique-gold compass at its lower right. Drawing is richly painted but clear at small phone UI size, a Russian fairy-tale collectible game control. Keep the bottom 22 percent as plain dark navy opaque surface for a live localized label; map and compass must not overlap this empty area. Match the modest ornament weight and subject position of the first reference card, not the large crest complexity. Warm antique-gold highlights from upper left, deep natural shadows, parchment cream, sapphire blue, restrained polished highlights, no neon. Actual transparent pixels ONLY outside the complete card outline, intentionally opaque navy panel inside the frame. No letters, words, numbers, glyph markings on the compass, watermark, caption, mockup scene, foliage, background scenery, checkerboard, or extra objects. A single complete standalone sprite, not a page or atlas.
